title: Which departments the add-backs run through
question: Where does add-back money go once it leaves the Board’s list?
finding: 40% of itemised add-back dollars are placed in three departments (Mayor’s Office (housing and community development), Children, Youth and Their Families, Economic and Workforce Development); these are departments that hand most of their program money to outside organisations by grant.
how: Each itemised first-year line is assigned to the department printed beside it (codes cleaned up, e.g. OEWD and ECN are one department). The last column is what that department paid the 444 profiled nonprofits in fiscal years 2019–2026, from the City ledger, for scale.
limits: The list says which department gets the money and for what purpose, not who is paid; the department chooses the grantee afterwards, by its own process. Department codes on scanned lists are sometimes unreadable and fall under "Other".
